text:
Maya L: @channel New rollout: were shipping a Dedicated Fallback & Priority Buckets policy. Purpose: improve reliability during cross-region strain by making routing decisions predictable and visible to customers. Please review and surface any blockers.
Jordan M: TL;DR: three priority buckets (urgent, standard, best-effort). Routes without explicit SLA tags default to standard. Buckets control: (1) routing priority, (2) allowed fallback GPU families, (3) burst eligibility.
Samir G: how do buckets map to GPU families?
Maya L: mapping example:
- urgent -> prefer reserved H200, fallback to H200-reserved-other-az, NO auto-fallback to A10G/L4p.
- standard -> prefer H200, fallback to A10G (compatible models), fallback to l4p-compact for short-seq jobs.
- best-effort -> prefer preemptible pools (h200-preemptible/mi300e-burst), then A10G, then l4p-compact.
Priya K: are these customer-configurable?
Maya L: Yes: console+API. Customers can set route.bucket = {urgent,standard,best-effort} or leave default. Enterprise contracts can lock buckets to ensure no cross-GPU fallback.
EngInfra: operator tools?
Samir G: example helper to list routes and current bucket:
```
redwoodctl routes list --fields id,customer_id,route_name,bucket,gpu_hint
```
Samir G: and to preview fallback chain for a route:
```
redwoodctl routes show --id <route> --preview-fallbacks
```
SRE-Oncall: alerts/telemetry?
Maya L: new alerts: `dedicated.fallback.degraded_routing` (fires when >5% of requests are served by non-primary GPU family for 10m), `dedicated.bucket.misconfig` (if urgent-route allowed fallback), and `dedicated.fallback.latency_regression` (if avg tail p99 increases >20% after fallback events). OpsBot will post daily fallback summaries in #eng-sre during rollout.
CostOps: billing note: when we fallback to a different GPU family, billing continues at the originally requested SKU rate for the remainder of the request; however for long-running jobs you may see a secondary line-item `fallback_gpu_adjustment` if migration crosses billing windows. We'll add details to pricing docs.
Priya K: What about pinned models and quantization-sensitive workloads?
Jordan M: pinned_model remains honored. If a route is pinned to a model+gpu combo, we will NOT auto-fallback. Instead we surface an actionable alert and offer a migration plan. Customers can allow an "opt-in fallback" to try best-effort runs on compatible families.
EngInfra: rollout plan?
Maya L: rollout stages: 1) internal preview (next Tue) in staging; 2) soft-launch (select customers in eu-west-1 + us-west-2) for 2 weeks; 3) global rollout after verification. Config flags: `--feature fallback-priority-buckets` for internal toggle.
SRE-Oncall: capacity mechanics? risk of unexpected spikes?
Maya L: well constrain fallback allocations with two levers: per-customer fallback cap (default 15% of route baseline) and regional fallback pool cap (configurable). If fallback demand exceeds caps we will queue requests rather than evict reserved jobs.
Samir G: CLI to list fallback allocations in a region:
```
redwoodctl allocations list --filter "fallback_active=true" --fields allocation_id,customer_id,route_id,allocated_gpus
```
SupportBot: [automated] Created doc stub: "Fallback & Priority Buckets FAQ" and prepopulated customer banner text for console review.
CostOps: early numbers: fallback A10G for a standard H200 job shows median token cost delta -6% or +4% depending on batch size and kv-cache behavior. We will publish a per-model delta table.
Priya K: How will customers be alerted? Console banner? email?
Maya L: Tiered notifications: 1) console banner for soft-launch customers; 2) in-console route alert + email for production fallback events; 3) escalation to account team if fallback persists >24h.
EngInfra: Do we have an automated migration flow if a customer accepts fallback and wants to make it permanent?
Jordan M: Yes: one-click migration in Console which (a) re-pins route to target GPU family, (b) optionally re-quantizes model via a guided job, and (c) runs a small smoke test. We'll publish docs and a CLI: `redwoodctl routes migrate --to a10g --route <id>`.
SRE-Oncall: when does alert `dedicated.fallback.degraded_routing` fire relative to rollout?
Maya L: alert enabled at soft-launch; will be in PagerDuty for oncall during the 2-week window. Thresholds adjustable via `ops.fallback.thresholds`.
CostOps: action: publish fallback cost estimator widget in Console (EOD Fri).
EngInfra: action: add `--preview-fallbacks` flag to redwoodctl and ensure exports include pinned_model and quantization info (2 business days).
SupportBot: [automated] Created reminders: staging preview next Tue 09:00 UTC; soft-launch invites to be sent tomorrow.
Maya L: Please review the internal spec: <https://go.redwood.ai/internal/dedicated/fallback-priority-buckets>. Post blockers here or ping me directly. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
